name: Toast for dinner
intro: Thick sourdough, crisped in olive oil, with something good on top. Ten minutes, and it still counts as dinner.

proteins.name: Fried eggs
proteins.timing: Cooked in the same pan after the toast, about 3 minutes.

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a skillet. Lay the bread in and press it down. Toast until golden and crisp on both sides.
Eggs: crack them into the same pan and cook until the whites set. Lamb: warm it through. Fish: nothing to cook.
Spread your flavor on the hot toast first, then the protein, then the arugula.
Flaky salt over the top. Eat it right away.

leftovers: Toast doesn't keep. Make it fresh.
